question:
Select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in the given number series.

26, 37, 50, 65, ?, 101
solution:
The logic followed here is: Double addition series.

 
• **Number increasing by +11, +13, +15, +17, +19 (addition of 2 in each number).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca581faa9c89201e205df6ed0c25d94fcd56fe4567ffac1723b3551d0badbf5a.png] 

Hence,the correct answer is** "82".**
